headline: OpenAI puts Pro subscriptions on hold due to Astra demand
angle: A company literally can't handle people paying them money because they're too busy serving a free/cheaper product—the economic equivalent of turning away customers at a restaurant because the early bird special is too popular.
scene: A customer in business casual holds a credit card, standing at an OpenAI service desk. Behind the desk, a tired employee wearing a headset blocks the registration window with both palms facing outward. In the background, dozens of people happily use Astra on their laptops, completely unaware of the chaos they've caused.
setup: Sorry, we're too popular. Can you come back when we're less successful?
punchline: We had to shut down the paying tier to make room for the free one.
instagram_caption: Nothing says thriving business like telling customers their money isn't welcome right now.
